items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You ought to go down to Bill Russell's shop and play a little for him.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's Southern. That's on that magazine.
Mm-hmm. You still play violin? Yeah, I still play violin. You ought to go down to Bill Russell's shop and play a little for him.
Well, I used to be master once. It's been so long. Violin is an instrument that if you stay away from it longer, I'd stay away from it. But I used to be one of the greatest of it.
